source_caption_text:
King Von revealed it was ‘never a money thing’ for him 😳💰

King Von, born Dayvon Daquan Bennett on August 9, 1994, was an American rapper and songwriter from the South Side of Chicago. He became a standout figure in the drill music scene, widely recognized for his vivid, vivid storytelling and aggressive delivery about life growing up in the Parkway Garden Homes area, commonly referred to as “O’Block”.

After spending several years facing legal troubles, he turned to music around 2018 upon signing with fellow Chicago artist Lil Durk’s label, Only the Family (OTF). King Von achieved breakout success with his single “Crazy Story” in late 2018, followed by hits like “Took Her to the O”. His debut studio album, *Welcome to O’Block*, was released in October 2020 and achieved significant commercial success.

Shortly after the release of his debut album, King Von was fatally shot during an altercation outside a nightclub in Atlanta, Georgia, on November 6, 2020, at the age of 26. Multiple posthumous projects, including *What It Means to Be King* (2022) and *Grandson* (2023), were released after his passing, cementing his legacy as one of the defining voices of modern drill rap.
